what: On first open, a pale gray logo lies in the center of a background-colored curtain, then after 1s the same logo fills from the bottom up in ink black over 2.5s (CSS ease). At 3.4s the whole curtain lifts up in .3s ease-in-out (.5s ease-out on phones 835 and below) and fires fx:done — a personal site hero where a logo with crisp outlines, like a text logo or name stamp, fills like water.

options.[data-fx-part=logo]: Logo that fills up (child) — artwork uses fill="currentColor" Draw it as. The part clones one copy and overlaps it
options.ease: Fill-up curve (GSAP name or ”0.25,0.1,0.25,1”), default CSS ease
options.out: When the curtain starts to lift (seconds after opening), default 3.4 — near 0 lifts it right away
options.narrow: Viewport width for the phone layout (px), default 835
options.out-dur-narrow / out-ease-narrow: Panel retract length and curve on phone, default .5 · 0,0,0.58,1
options.--fx-fill / --fx-base / --fx-ink: Curtain color · underlying logo color · filling color (via style), default background · --kf-raised · --kf-ink
options.look: If fade, the veil does not lift up but blurs out in place over out-dur (media-brand splash) — default is to lift up
options.wait: With load, it starts filling only after waiting for both font readiness and window load (media-brand) — default is immediately on attach

from.where: shared.js · shared.css .sk-loader (first page only — original #loading: a box holding loading100.svg over loading0.svg goes height 0→100% with animation 2.5s ease 1s, then at setTimeout 3400 .is-active → translateY(-100%) .3s ease-in-out (835 and below .5s ease-out))

index.html .ma-splash (150px school mark in the middle of a white curtain — orange fills up from the bottom over gray #cecece in 2s power1.out, rests .2s, then fades out in .5s power1.in. The original waits for fonts and images to be ready before starting the fill)
from.options: wait: load; delay: 0; fill: 2; ease: power1.out; out: 2.2; out-dur: 0.5; out-ease: power1.in; out-dur-narrow: 0.5; out-ease-narrow: power1.in; look: fade
